title: Thalāthat-ul-Usūl (The Three Fundamental Principles)
description: Study the three fundamental principles of Islam (الثلاثة الأصول) by Imam Muhammad ibn Abdul-Wahhab - the purpose of life, knowledge of the religion, and evidence for the religion. This foundational text covers the three questions every person will be asked in the grave, with lessons from the Salafi Arabic Reading Program.
short_description: Learn the three fundamental principles of Islam by Imam Muhammad ibn Abdul-Wahhab
